```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse); library(MASS); library(kableExtra); library(lubridate); library(texreg); library(vtable); library(marginaleffects); library(ggpubr); library(grid)
```

```{r}
#| label: loading data

bluesky <- readr::read_csv("data/bluesky_classified.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: recoding

bluesky1 <- bluesky |>
  mutate(
    stance = ifelse(final_label == 1, "Pro", "Non-pro"),
    day = as.Date(timestamp),
    weekday = factor(wday(day, label = TRUE))
  ) |>
  group_by(day, stance, weekday) |>
  summarise(
    n_daydate = n(),
    m_engagement = mean(reply_count + like_count + repost_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_posts = n_distinct(post_id),
    active_users = n_distinct(user_handle),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bluesky2 <- bluesky1 |>
  mutate(
    time = as.integer(day - min(day)) + 1,
    ceasefire = ifelse(day >= as.Date("2025-09-29"), 1, 0),
    time_after = ifelse(
      day >= as.Date("2025-09-29"),
      as.integer(day - as.Date("2025-09-29")) + 1,
      0
    )
  )
```

## Operationalisation and Modelling

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consetetur sadipscing elitr, sed diam nonumy eirmod tempor invidunt ut labore et dolore magna aliquyam erat, sed diam voluptua. At vero eos et accusam et justo duo dolores et ea rebum. Stet clita kasd gubergren, no sea takimata sanctus est Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.

$$
\log(\mu_t) = \beta_0
+ \beta_1 \,\mathrm{Time}_t
+ \beta_2 \,\mathrm{Ceasefire}_t
+ \beta_3 \,\mathrm{TimeAfter}_t,
\qquad
\mathrm{NumberOfPosts}_t \sim \mathrm{NegBin}(\mu_t,\theta)
$$

where $\text{NumberOfPosts}_t$ denotes the number of posts on day $t$ by stance, 
$\text{Time}_t$ captures the baseline time trend, 
$\text{Ceasefire}_t$ is a binary indicator for the ceasefire announcement period, 
and $\text{TimeAfter}_t$ measures the post-ceasefire time trend.

```{r}
ceasefire <- as.Date("2025-09-29")

ggplot(

) +

    linetype = "dashed",

    y = max(bluesky2$n_daydate) * 0.65,

    vjust = -0.7,
    hjust = -.2,
    size = 3

  labs(
    title = "Pro vs. Non-pro Posts per Day on Bluesky",
    x = "Day",
    y = "Number of posts",
    color = "Stance"

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray80",
      linewidth = .2
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
# Models NB and OLS
## NB
npostspro_nb1 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after,
                        data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))

npostspro_nb2 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday,
                        data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))

npostspro_nb3 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday + # total_posts removed because of collinearity,
                          active_users,
                        data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))

## OLS
engpro_ols4 <- glm(log(m_engagement + 1) ~ 
                       time + 
                       ceasefire + 
                       time_after,
                     data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"),
                  family = "gaussian")

engpro_ols5 <- glm(log(m_engagement + 1) ~ 
                       time + 
                       ceasefire + 
                       time_after +
                       weekday,
                     data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"),
                  family = "gaussian")

engpro_ols6 <- glm(log(m_engagement + 1) ~ 
                       time + 
                       ceasefire + 
                       time_after +
                       weekday +
                       total_posts +
                       active_users,
                     data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"),
                   family = "gaussian")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mainmodels
#| tbl-cap: "Main Models"
#| results: asis
#| output: true
#| include: true

texreg(
  list(npostspro_nb1, 
       npostspro_nb2, 
       npostspro_nb3, 
       engpro_ols4,
       engpro_ols5,
       engpro_ols6),
  custom.model.names = c("Posts",
                         "Posts", 
                         "Posts", 
                         "log(Engagement)", 
                         "log(Engagement)", 
                         "log(Engagement)"),
  custom.coef.map = list(
    "time" = "Time",
    "ceasefire" = "Ceasefire",
    "time_after" = "After Ceasefire",
    "weekday" = "Weekday",
    "total_posts" = "Posts per Day",
    "active_users" = "Daily Users",
    "(Intercept)" = "Constant"
  ),
  custom.gof.rows = list(
    "Estimator" = c(
      "NegBin", "NegBin", "NegBin",
      "OLS", "OLS", "OLS"
      ),
    "Weekday fixed effects" = c("No","Yes","Yes","No","Yes","Yes")
    ),
  digits = 2,
  single.row = FALSE,
  caption.above = TRUE,
  table = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-meplot
#| fig-cap: "Marginal Effects of Ceasefire over Time"
#| include: true

me_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray80",
      linewidth = .2
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Model A: marginal effect of ceasefire across time
marg_A <- plot_slopes(
  npostspro_nb1,
  variables = "ceasefire",
  condition = "time",
  conf_level = 0.95
) +
  geom_rug(
    data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"),
    mapping = aes(x = time),
    sides = "b",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.3,
    length = grid::unit(0.03, "npc")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  me_theme +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Marginal effect of Ceasefire",
    caption = "Model 1"
  )

# Model B: marginal effect of ceasefire across time
marg_B <- plot_slopes(
  npostspro_nb3,
  variables = "ceasefire",
  condition = "time",
  conf_level = 0.95
) +
  geom_rug(
    data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"),
    mapping = aes(x = time),
    sides = "b",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.3,
    length = grid::unit(0.03, "npc")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  me_theme +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Marginal effect of Ceasefire",
    caption = "Model 3"
  )

marg_all <- ggarrange(
  marg_A, marg_B,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "bottom"
)

marg_all
```

```{r}
# Models Poisson for first three model Robustness

                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after,
                      family = poisson(link = "log"),
                      data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))

                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday,
                     family = poisson(link = "log"),
                     data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))

poissonpostspro_nb3 <- glm(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday + # total_posts removed because of collinearity,
                          active_users,
                     family = poisson(link = "log"),
                     data = subset(bluesky2, stance == "Pro"))
```

```{r}
# NB on ceasfire breach for robustness

breach <- as.Date("2025-10-19") # coding breach #https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/oct/19/gaza-ceasefire-israel-hamas-rafah-hostages-middle-east-crisis-live-news-updates

bluesky3 <- bluesky2 |>
  filter(
    day >= breach - 21,
    day <= breach + 12
  )

bluesky4 <- bluesky3 |>
  mutate(
    breach = ifelse(day >= breach, 1, 0),
    time_after_breach = ifelse(
      day >= breach,
      as.integer(day - breach) + 1,
      0
    )
  )


## NB Models
breach_npostspro_nb1 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          breach + 
                          time_after,
                        data = subset(bluesky4, stance == "Pro"))

breach_npostspro_nb2 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          breach + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday,
                        data = subset(bluesky4, stance == "Pro"))

breach_npostspro_nb3 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          breach + 
                          time_after +
                          weekday + # total_posts removed because of collinearity,
                          active_users,
                        data = subset(bluesky4, stance == "Pro"))
```

```{r}
# Models NB on reduced dataset for robustness

bluesky_reduced <- bluesky |> 
  filter(
    !is.na(labels) |
      prob_pro >= 0.9 |
      prob_pro <= 0.1
  )

bluesky_reduced1 <- bluesky_reduced |>
  mutate(
    stance = ifelse(final_label == 1, "Pro", "Non-pro"),
    day = as.Date(timestamp),
    weekday = factor(wday(day, label = TRUE))
  ) |>
  group_by(day, stance, weekday) |>
  summarise(
    n_daydate = n(),
    m_engagement = mean(reply_count + repost_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_posts = n_distinct(post_id),
    active_users = n_distinct(user_handle),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bluesky_reduced2 <- bluesky_reduced1 |>
  mutate(
    time = as.integer(day - min(day)) + 1,
    ceasefire = ifelse(day >= as.Date("2025-09-29"), 1, 0),
    time_after = ifelse(
      day >= as.Date("2025-09-29"),
      as.integer(day - as.Date("2025-09-29")) + 1,
      0
    )
  )

# Models NB reduced
red_npostspro_nb1 <- glm.nb(n_daydate ~ 
                          time + 
                          ceasefire + 
                          time_after,

                        data = subset(bluesky_reduced2, stance == "Pro"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mainmodelsreduced

#| results: asis

#| include: true

texreg(
  list(red_npostspro_nb1, 
       red_npostspro_nb2, 
       red_npostspro_nb3),
  custom.model.names = c("Posts",
                         "Posts", 
                         "Posts"),
  custom.coef.map = list(
    "time" = "Time",
    "ceasefire" = "Ceasefire",
    "time_after" = "After Ceasefire",
    "weekday" = "Weekday",
#    "total_posts" = "Posts per Day", # not incuded in these models
    "active_users" = "Daily Users",
    "(Intercept)" = "Constant"
  ),
  custom.gof.rows = list(
    "Estimator" = c(
      "NegBin", "NegBin", "NegBin"
      ), "Weekday fixed effects" = c("No","Yes","Yes")
    ),
  digits = 2,
  single.row = FALSE,
  caption.above = TRUE,
  table = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-codebook
#| tbl-cap: "Coding Scheme"
#| include: true

keywords <- tibble(
  "Label" = c(
    
    "pro", "anti", "neutral", "noclass"),
  
  "Definition" = c(
    
    "Post contains a boycott appeal. As such all posts expressing a pro-boycott stance are included, e.g., 
    calls to action, promotion, support, or justification",
  
    "Explicit or implicit rejection of Israel boycotts, or BDS as a movement or tactic.",
                   
    "Discussion of Israel-related boycott activity which does not take a pro or anti-boycott
    stance but simply discusses factual, non-opinionated information.",
                   
    "Posts that do not discuss the Israel-Palestine conflict as a topic, or they discuss the
    Israel-Palestine conflict, but the posts does not relate to boycott activity."),
                   
  "Examples" = c(
    
    "“Don’t buy Israeli products.” 
    
    “BDS is a peaceful way to end apartheid.” 
    
    “BDS.” 
    
    “We must boycott until human rights are respected.”",
  
    "“BDS is antisemitic.”
    
    “The boycotts do more harm than good.”
    
    “Boycotts won’t bring peace.”
    
    “Israeli businesses provide jobs for both sides.”",
    
    "“Israel has lost [amount] of revenue due to boycotts.”
    
    “Calls for boycotts of Israel have increased/declined.”",
    
    "“Free Palestine.” 
    
    “Israel has a right to exist.”
    
    “Russia should be sanctioned, products boycotted.”"
    )
  )

keywords <- keywords |>
  mutate(Label = paste0("\\textit{", Label, "}"))

keywords |>
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, format = "latex", align = "l", escape = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(1:3, hline_after = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), font_size = 8, full_width = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "1.5cm") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "6.5cm") |>
  column_spec(3, width = "6.5cm")
```
